verdict.rationale: Slate is a coding agent, so plugging in MCP servers as a client is an applicable axis. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP server support or configuration. The docs cover skills (markdown instruction packages), permissions, models and shell commands, but none of these are MCP tool integration and they do not count as adjacent credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
